about: Live Claude Copilot cases, written before any live run. Deterministic checks: citation correctness (every cited ID was retrieved and is in allowed_cites when given), citation completeness (share of expect_cites cited), numeric accuracy (claims whose numbers are absent from the cited evidence are counted), condition terms present, abstention and boundary behaviour. An optional LLM judge scores claim entailment and is reported separately as indicative only.
